question: I'd like to hear Felis' feelings about Crusch!!
answer: He's already written several dozen volumes of the record of his feelings, called "Crusch-sama the Great" that he can't talk about enough, and in later years it will become a vital historial record for learning about the person called Crusch Karsten, but the majority of the contents will overpraise Crusch so much, even historical researchers won't be able to read it without taking a break every five minutes, since it's so sweet.
